# Artemis Atelier Ltd

> Lagos, Nigeria design and construction firm (RC 1484495), in practice since 2010. Designs, builds and renovates homes, estates, churches and commercial buildings for clients in Nigeria and the diaspora.

- Address: 70B Olorunlogbon Street, Anthony Village, Lagos, Nigeria
- Phone/WhatsApp: +234 803 350 2393
- Services: architecture and design, residential construction, renovation and interiors, commercial and institutional buildings, project management
- How we protect clients: live site cameras, stage-gate payments verified by an independent inspector, open-book BOQs, insurance partner, 6-12 month defect liability period, full as-built handover pack
